title: Source Onboarding
note: MTX-055 (AC-PRULE-004) also carries S-04 but is owned and contracted by S-03, so that one row has one canonical contract. PRULE-005 belongs to CAP-005/WF-003 and is owned by S-05.

MTX-004.interface_type: One application command registering exactly one proposed Source under the `source-registration-v1` contract. Reached by a principal holding `source.register`, so a transport exposure is expected at the Volume II baseline.
MTX-004.route: Not applicable - Volume I defines the command, its permission and its complete envelope but no HTTP path, method or transport. Transport exposure is owned by API_CONTRACTS.md at the Volume II baseline; asserting a path here would fix a product contract Volume I has not defined.
MTX-004.request_schema: `source-registration-v1`: one `submitted_root_uri` with grammar `https://<host>` or `https://<host>/`, target Project identity, and the global command envelope including the idempotency key. An explicit `:443` is accepted and removed. Registration provenance is derived from the command and the authorization decision rather than supplied by the caller.
MTX-004.response_schema: Exactly one proposed Source with its Source ID, canonical root URI, canonical host, lifecycle status `proposed` and state version; or one enumerated rejection reason with no Source. No Onboarding Request and no plural candidate entity is ever returned.
MTX-004.controller: Not applicable - no HTTP adapter is defined by Volume I; see route.
MTX-004.command: `Workflows::Wf004::RegisterSource`. Registration never verifies, activates, crawls or creates Evidence; each of those is a separate command in a later slice.
MTX-004.command_input: Normalized `submitted_root_uri`, Project identity, expected state version, and the command envelope. Host normalization is `ascii-host-v1`: lowercase A-Z, remove one terminal dot, require 1-253 remaining bytes and at least two dot-separated labels, and require every label to be 1-63 ASCII letters, digits or hyphens without a leading or trailing hyphen. A pre-encoded `xn--` label is allowed. Raw Unicode is `source_host_non_ascii` and MUST NOT be normalized by the implementation, because Volume I fixes that reason precisely so implementations cannot diverge on IDNA handling.
MTX-004.command_output: Exactly one proposed Source with immutable provenance and one `SourceRegistered` event; or no Source and one audited command outcome.
MTX-004.actor: Organization Administrator, Marketing Operator or Technical Implementer holding `source.register` over the target Project.
MTX-004.organization_scope: An active Organization, and a same-Organization Project in `draft`, `active` or `paused`. Project activation is expressly not a prerequisite.
MTX-004.aggregate_boundary: Source is its own root, referencing Organization and Project by identity. It is not a child of Project. Volume I states that no separate Onboarding Request or Source-candidate entity is created, so no intermediate aggregate may be introduced to stage a registration.
MTX-004.value_objects: SourceId, SubmittedRootUri, CanonicalRootUri (`https://<lowercase_host>/`), CanonicalHost, RegistrationProvenance, SourceStateVersion.
MTX-004.domain_service: Not applicable - the URI grammar and host normalization are pure functions applied in the application command; Volume I names no domain service.
MTX-004.repository: `SourceRepository`; `ProjectRepository` read-only for the Project state precondition.
MTX-004.persistence_model: Canonical `sources` table per schemas/POSTGRESQL_SCHEMA.md. A Source carries Source ID, Organization and Project IDs, submitted and canonical root URIs, canonical host, `registration_schema_version=source-registration-v1`, `host_normalization_version=ascii-host-v1`, immutable registration provenance, lifecycle status initially `proposed`, state version, and registered and updated times.
MTX-004.migration: Not applicable at this row - the canonical `sources` table already exists. The uniqueness key `(project_id, canonical_host)` over every Source not `removed` is a partial unique index in the canonical schema; this row adds no schema object.
MTX-004.transaction_boundary: One transaction: validate, check uniqueness, insert exactly one proposed Source with its immutable provenance, emit `SourceRegistered`. The uniqueness check and the insert serialize, so the check cannot pass and then be raced.
MTX-004.concurrency: The uniqueness check and insert serialize on `(project_id, canonical_host)` across every Source not `removed`. Two concurrent commands for the same key create exactly one Source; the loser receives `F1-DOMAIN-409 / source_host_already_registered`. A committed removed Source does not reopen: a later command creates a new Source with a new ID and new provenance, and never attaches to the removed lineage.
MTX-004.idempotency: Idempotent by the command idempotency key. Exact replay returns the same Source and emits no second `SourceRegistered`. Changed content under the same key is `idempotency_conflict`. The idempotency key is also recorded inside the immutable registration provenance, so the replay identity is auditable from the Source itself.
MTX-004.background_job: Not applicable - registration is synchronous. Volume I states registration never verifies, activates, crawls or creates Evidence, so there is no deferred work to enqueue.
MTX-004.retry_policy: Two service retries at exactly 1 and 5 seconds for transient transaction or dependency failure, per AC-CAP-004. No validation, host, state, tenant, permission, duplicate or replay reason is retried.
MTX-004.terminal_failure: Retry exhaustion creates no Source and emits one audited command outcome. Every rejection is terminal for the attempt and leaves no Source, no partial record and no candidate entity.
MTX-004.reconciliation: Not applicable - the command is atomic and single-root, and a rejection creates nothing, so no divergent state exists to reconcile.
MTX-004.domain_events: `SourceRegistered` on success, exactly once. Nothing on rejection: every rejection emits one audited command outcome rather than an event.
MTX-004.event_payload: Event envelope plus Source identity, Project identity, canonical host and canonical root URI, registration and normalization versions, provenance actor and command, and state version. It MUST NOT carry a submitted email, identity subject, credential or raw authorization token.
MTX-004.event_consumers: Not applicable at this row - Volume I names no consumer of `SourceRegistered`. Verification (S-05) is triggered by its own command, not by this event.
MTX-004.serializer: Not applicable - no transport exposure is defined by Volume I; see route.
MTX-004.authorization_entry_point: The application command, before validation of the URI and before any insert. The authorization decision ID is captured into the immutable registration provenance, so every Source carries proof of the decision that created it.
MTX-004.permission_checks: `source.register` over the target Project, held by an Organization Administrator, Marketing Operator or Technical Implementer. Absence is `source_register_unauthorized`. The Organization MUST be active and the Project MUST be in `draft`, `active` or `paused`; any other Project state is `project_not_registerable`.
MTX-004.tenant_boundary: The Project MUST be same-Organization; otherwise `tenant_mismatch`. The uniqueness key is Project-scoped, so the same canonical host may exist in different Projects and different Organizations without collision.
MTX-004.error_contract: First-match order, normative: `source_request_schema_unsupported`, `source_uri_malformed`, `unsupported_source_scheme`, `source_userinfo_prohibited`, `source_port_unsupported`, `source_path_not_root`, `source_query_prohibited`, `source_fragment_prohibited`, `source_host_non_ascii`, `source_host_invalid`, `organization_inactive`, `project_not_registerable`, `tenant_mismatch`, `source_register_unauthorized`, `stale_state_version`, `source_host_already_registered`, `idempotency_conflict`. Class mapping is fixed: schema, URI and host reasons to `F1-VALIDATION-400`; inactive, state, duplicate and replay reasons to `F1-DOMAIN-409`; tenant and permission reasons to `F1-AUTH-403`. Every rejection creates no Source and emits one audited command outcome.
MTX-004.audit_record: The immutable registration provenance is itself the audit anchor: `origin=human_command`, registering Account ID, command ID, idempotency key, Identity/Session authorization-decision ID, registered time and correlation ID. Every rejection emits one audited command outcome carrying its first-match reason and correlation ID.
MTX-004.observability: `SourceRegistered` plus onboarding telemetry per CAP-004 Observability Requirements. Telemetry MUST NOT carry a submitted email, identity subject, credential or raw authorization token, matching the event-payload prohibition.
MTX-004.retention: Source registration metadata and provenance records are stored per CAP-004 Data Implications. Provenance is immutable. The retention window is owned by specification/015 DATA_LIFECYCLE.md; this row states none.
MTX-004.test_contracts: TYP-DATA: grammar - `https://host` and `https://host/` accepted; `https://host:443` and `https://host:443/` accepted with the port removed. TYP-DATA: each first-match reason in order - a nondefault port is `source_port_unsupported` and not `source_uri_malformed`, proving the order is applied rather than approximated. TYP-DATA: user information, query, fragment, nonroot path, wildcard, IP literal, bracketed literal, non-HTTPS scheme and ASCII control/space each produce their exact reason and no Source. TYP-DATA: host normalization - uppercase lowercased; one terminal dot removed; 253/254-byte boundary; single-label host rejected; a 63/64-character label boundary; leading and trailing hyphen rejected. TYP-DATA: a pre-encoded `xn--` label is accepted; raw Unicode is `source_host_non_ascii` and is never normalized to punycode by the implementation. TYP-DATA: canonical root URI is `https://<lowercase_host>/` for every accepted input. TYP-SEC: `organization_inactive`, `project_not_registerable`, `tenant_mismatch` and `source_register_unauthorized` each create no Source. TYP-INT: a Project in `draft`, `active` and `paused` each permit registration - the paused fixture asserts that reading the paused state as a guard is permitted while no path effects the transition. TYP-DATA: uniqueness on `(project_id, canonical_host)` over non-removed Sources; the same host in a different Project succeeds. TYP-DATA: concurrent same-key registration creates exactly one Source and the loser receives `F1-DOMAIN-409 / source_host_already_registered`. TYP-DATA: post-removal re-registration creates a new Source with a new ID and new provenance and never reopens the removed record. TYP-DATA: exact replay returns the same Source and emits one event only; changed content under the same key is `idempotency_conflict`. TYP-OBS: the 10-second timeout and the exact 1/5-second retry schedule. TYP-OBS: provenance is exactly the seven named fields and is immutable after commit. TYP-SEC: the `SourceRegistered` payload carries no submitted email, identity subject, credential or raw authorization token. TYP-DATA: registration creates no Onboarding Request and no candidate entity, and never verifies, activates, crawls or creates Evidence.
MTX-004.rollout: No predecessor behaviour exists. S-04 depends on S-03 for a registerable Project and is consumed by S-05 verification and S-06 scope control.
